description.zh: 您的阿里云账号（主账号）ID。
description.en: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: 函数的调用开始日期，格式为**EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**。
description.en: The time when the function is invoked. The value is in the **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT** format.

description.zh: 函数计算调用请求的调用链ID。
description.en: The trace ID of the request for Function Compute API.

description.zh: 限定此次返回资源的数量。如果不设定，默认返回20，最大不能超过100。返回结果可能小于指定的数量，但不会多于指定的数量。
description.en: The maximum number of results to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100. The number of returned resources is less than or equal to the specified number.

description.zh: 用来返回更多结果。第一次查询不需要提供这个参数，后续查询的token从返回结果中获取。
description.en: The token required to obtain more results. You do not need to specify this parameter in the first call. If a NextToken value is returned by a previous call, more results are available.

description.zh: 限定返回的资源名称必须属于该qualifier。qualifier只能是aliasName，且必须和serviceName共同使用。
description.en: The qualifier of the service to which resources belong. The qualifier must be aliasName and used together with the serviceName parameter.

description.zh: 限定返回的资源名称必须属于该service。
description.en: The name of the service to which resources belong.

title.zh: 获取预留函数配置列表信息
